name: maestro
description: Maestro Frontier model-panel fusion with Opus 5, current Codex models, validated effort control, Codex skills, and optional lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Frontier panel composition, Codex skills, and lifecycle hooks
interface.longDescription: Install Maestro in Codex as a plugin: direct /maestro slash hub to compose an Opus 5 and Codex model panel, set validated effort, and run the local read-only Frontier fusion engine. Optional discipline hooks remain independent and off by default.
